title: MeDIP-Seq/DIP-Seq/hMeDIP-Seq
scope: Illumina family-level explanatory schematic: one route from chromatin-associated Methylated DNA through Extract DNA, Fractionate / Denature, Immunoprecipitate and DNA purification to DNA. The leftmost vignette and long assay caption introduce the method; they have no transfer arrow to the main start and are not a separate assay branch. The visible magenta antibodies are affinity-selection reagents, not enzymes acting on chromatin. No end-group chemistry, adapters, library construction or sequencing is drawn. The purified enriched DNA is the depicted endpoint and the source of a subsequent sequencing library described in the catalogue and cited implementations. Antibody targets and implementation evidence are qualified below; the grouped names do not establish alias equivalence or historical lineage.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate
operations.description: Bind and retain DNA fragments using antibodies directed to the selected cytosine modification. The dark red-marked fragments become antibody-associated; pale fragments indicate background outside the retained route.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-dependent affinity enrichment of modification-bearing DNA, with the target qualified by method scope. Antibodies are selection reagents, not newly generated DNA products.
operations.information_effect: Selection links genomic fragment identity to the modification recognized by the antibody. It enriches fragments rather than identifying every modified nucleotide; specificity and selectivity require testing.

operations.label: DNA purification
operations.description: Recover DNA from the immunoprecipitated material, yielding the short DNA fragments drawn at the right without antibody icons. No purification chemistry is specified.
operations.information_effect: Purified captured genomic DNA supplies the downstream library. The cited DIP-Seq and hMeDIP-Seq implementations amplify the captured DNA, so their library molecules are copies of selected genomic fragments. Sequenced tags locate regional modification enrichment; the target association is supplied by antibody capture, not by a depicted base-conversion code. The catalogue describes fragment-scale resolution (approximately 150 bp), density bias and possible nonspecific interaction; this readout does not by itself establish single-base modification states or absolute modified-base fractions. Library construction and sequencing remain text-supported downstream uses, outside the drawn operation graph.

method_scopes.rationale: The cited Shen implementation resolves antibody-dependent capture of sonicated, adaptor-ligated genomic DNA, with recovery of captured DNA for amplification and sequencing. Its tested targets include 5fC and 5caC as well as 5mC and 5hmC; these are separate antibody selections, not a single mixed target assay. Capture and DNA recovery map to the two listed schematic operations. Fragmentation is supported, but denaturation within the combined Fractionate / Denature block is not specified in the available core methods paragraph [b00050], which refers to Extended Experimental Procedures. Extraction is shown at family level rather than described as an operation in that paragraph. The exact applicability of those two earlier schematic blocks to this paper is therefore not independently resolved here; their family-level depiction is retained.

unknowns.question: Which complete library-construction implementation should be attached to the final DNA endpoint for the grouped family? The figure ends at DNA. The cited DIP/hMeDIP papers support adapters already present before capture, but no universal library-preparation order or complete anti-5mC sequencing protocol follows from this drawing; a specific sequencing protocol would be needed for that extension.

What detailed immunocapture chemistry and preparation order did Weber et al. use? Only the abstract is supplied, and it reports microarray analysis. Full text would be needed for any protocol-specific or historical claim; this does not block the catalogue-supported schematic.

Does the cited Shen DIP-Seq implementation include the denaturation step within Illumina’s combined Fractionate / Denature block? The inspected core Experimental Procedures [b00050] specify sonicated, adaptor-ligated DNA but delegate detailed DIP procedures to Extended Experimental Procedures. That supplement or its expressly cited protocol would be needed to verify this variant-specific denaturation step; the family-level depicted block remains intact.
